pattern: put ( a | an ) {k:CounterKind} counter on each creature that convoked it
subject: none

examples.text: When ~ enters, scry 1, then put a flying counter on each creature that convoked it.
When ~ enters, draw a card, then put a lifelink counter on each creature that convoked it.

counterExamples: When ~ enters, put two flying counters on each creature that convoked it.
When ~ enters, put a flying counter on target creature that convoked it.
When ~ enters, put a flying counter on each creature that tapped for it.

pattern: manifest a number of cards from the top of your library equal to {q:Qty}
subject: none

examples.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, manifest a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of lands you control.
When ~ enters, manifest a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the number of creatures you control.

counterExamples: When ~ dies, manifest a number of cards from the top of target player's library equal to the number of counters on it.
When ~ dies, manifest a number of cards from your hand equal to the number of counters on it.
When ~ dies, manifest the top card of your library.

pattern: ~ enters with {m:Count} {k:CounterKind} counter[s] on it for each creature that convoked it
subject: none

examples.text: ~ enters with four +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that convoked it.
~ enters with three charge counters on it for each creature that convoked it.

counterExamples: ~ enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that tapped for it.
~ enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that convoked a spell.
~ enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each creature that convoked it this turn.
